phrases.breakdown: 出 act outward; 手 hand; 相 links the action to another; 救 rescue
phrases.explanation: A rescue idiom; rendering separate hands would invent a physical action.

phrases.pinyin: yǐ shāng hài bié rén wéi lè
phrases.breakdown: 以 take; 伤害 harm; 别人 others; 为 as; 乐 pleasure
phrases.explanation: 以…为乐 is a complete construction describing enjoyment, not merely causing harm; 乐 is lè here.
In the hostage line, not being killed is the condition on willingness to do anything.
